![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTM3OTc1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--117ea7584f97d6a870de6fde2e28c21cd79603ed/(White)%20Logo%20Semarang%20Open%202026.png)

The Speedcubing Tournament in Semarang City is back with a fresh new vibe! **Semarang Open 2026** is a one-day speedcubing competition featuring 3x3x3 as the main event, held at Hetero Space Semarang (Gatra Room, 3rd Floor). This competition is open to participants of all nationalities.

# Participants are allowed to bring more than one companion/guest; however, only one companion/guest is permitted to enter the competition room.

**Please note that your registration will not be accepted unless you have completed both the registration form and the registration fee payment. For further information, please contact the provided number.

Kompetisi speedcubing di Kota Semarang kini hadir kembali dengan nuansa yang baru. **Semarang Open 2026** adalah kompetisi speedcubing yang diadakan selama 1 hari dengan 3x3x3 sebagai cabang utamanya dan akan diadakan di Hetero Space Semarang, (Ruang Gatra, Lantai 3). Kompetisi ini terbuka untuk semua warga negara.

# Dibolehkan untuk membawa lebih dari 1 pendamping/tamu, namun hanya diizinkan membawa 1 pendamping/tamu untuk masuk ke dalam ruangan kompetisi

**Kami tidak akan menerima pendaftaran Anda jika Anda belum melakukan pembayaran Fee Registrasi dan mengisi formulir pendaftaran. Untuk informasi lebih lanjut, silakan menghubungi kontak yang tersedia**


**Important**
In accordance with articles [2g](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2g), [2k](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k), and [2l](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l), competitors that fail to abide by the specified WCA Regulations shall be disqualified, at the discretion of the WCA delegate.

items.information:
## VOLUNTEERING
Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8).

If any parents are willing to help judge or run, please watch the above video if you have not been a judge/runner at previous competitions. We greatly appreciate all assistance during the competition and more volunteers helping out during the competition helps to stay on schedule and not run behind.

## SPONSORSHIP

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTI5MTA0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--8009ba06c22285cc1d3d3488d30eaedc709350c8/IMG_6226.png)

A big thanks to [Cubestuff](https://cubestuff.co.za) who will co host this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to buy the different speedcubes they have on offer.
You can also go to Cubestuff.co.za to order a variety of cubes and equipment online. follow them on socials by scanning the QR Code below.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTY2MjcwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--bea620be86f2f2e79b7ff56af3eef8d900240518/IMG_2596.jpg)

The **Legacy Centurion Hotel** have gracouisly offered us the venue at a very reduced rate as part of their support for the competition. Please continue to return the favour to them by supporting their restaurant and accomodation. Also follow the hotel on socials by scanning the QR code below.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTY2MjY1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--781305c69b42fd5cad23e5a76d3b2c4c6e2cd2f3/IMG_2595.jpg)

##Accommodation 

The hotel have offered discounted accommodation rates to our cubers (and guests) for the weekend of the competition. You can book your accomodation by sending an email to Penny Mbobo pmbobo@legacyhotels.co.za and mention the code "Rubiks 2026" when making your booking. Reach out to the competition organizers or delegates if you have more questions.



## NOTICE FOR COMPETITORS
Be sure to be ready to compete in any of your scheduled events at least 30 minutes before the scheduled starting time.

## About CubingZA
CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country.
If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to improve competitive speedcubing in the country, please get in touch.

items.name: Cubing Bash Bloemfontein 2026
items.information:
[CubingZA](https://www.cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce Cubing Bash Bloemfontein 2026! Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, **and** pay for your ticket to confirm your entry. Please see **Registration Requirements** below for instructions and when registration opens.

### All New Competitors

If this is your **first time** competing, or the first time your child or ward is competing, please ensure to bring with some form of **ID (card, book, passport, birth certificate)** for the competitor so that we can verify that their name is spelled correctly, their Date of Birth is correct, and their Nationality is correct.
Please also ensure you have all the puzzles you need to compete - we do not supply puzzles for competitors. You are welcome to ask other competitors if you can borrow their puzzle for a certain event, but there is no guarantee.

items.name: Dobřejovice Special 2026
items.information:
# ENGLISH

**Mandatory Competition tutorial**

All competitors are required to complete the official competitor tutorial before being allowed to participate in the competition. This requirement applies to everyone, not only newcomers.
Competitors who do not attend the tutorial will not be permitted to compete.

**Special Competition Format**

This competition will be held using a special format in which all events run simultaneously.
Each competitor will have a 45-minute cumulative limit to complete attempts in any events they choose.


# ČESKY

**Povinný tutoriál pro soutěžící**

Všichni závodníci musí před začátkem soutěže absolvovat oficiální tutoriál. Tato povinnost platí pro všechny, nejen pro nováčky.
Závodníkům, kteří se tutoriálu nezúčastní, nebude umožněno soutěžit.

**Speciální formát soutěže**

Tato soutěž bude probíhat ve speciálním formátu, ve kterém všechny disciplíny běží zároveň.
Každý soutěžící má k dispozici 45 minut, během kterých může skládat libovolné disciplíny podle vlastního výběru.

items.information:
### Português

**Atencão:** Chegamos ao limite de inscrições, isso significa que novas inscrições serão aceitas **somente caso haja alguma desistência**.
Neste caso, entraremos em contato com todos os inscritos não confirmados via e-mail, daremos um período para que respondam manifestando interesse, e aprovaremos as inscrições pela ordem que foram feitas, mediante pagamento da taxa de inscrição (R$20).

Esta competição possui **limite de inscrições**, em caso de desistência, **entre em contato com a organização ([fcardim@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:fcardim@worldcubeassociation.org))** para que a vaga possa ser disponibilizada para outra pessoa.

#### Utilização de imagem
Há possibilidade de filmagem e fotografias durante a competição, por parte do shopping ou veículos de mídia autorizados. Ao se inscrever, você concorda que sua imagem pode ser utilizada pelo shopping ou seus parceiros, com fins monetários ou não, sem compensação ou crédito necessário. Ao manter sua inscrição, você também reconhece a leitura e ciência deste aviso.


### English:

**Attention:** We have reached the competitor limit, which means that new registrations will only be accepted **if there is a cancellation**.
In that case, we'll reach out to all not confirmed registered competitors through email. We'll give a time window answer, saying they're still interested in participating, and we'll approve the registrations in the order they happened, after paying the registration fee (R$20).

This competition has a **competitor limit**, in case of withdrawal, **contact the organization team ([fcardim@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:fcardim@worldcubeassociation.org))** so your spot can be given to someone else.

#### Image use
It's possible there will be photography and filming at the event, done by the mall or authorized media outlets. By registering, you agree that your image might be used by the shopping mall or its partners, for monetary gain or other purposes, without compensation or credit necessary. By keeping your registration, you also recognize to have read and granted permission to this.
